item.title: StarCraft II 5.0.17 Patch Notes
item.description:
[News] Based on feedback, we have rolled back most balance changes to the live release of StarCraft II from patch 5.0.16 to 5.0.15.

Blizzard

item.title: StarCraft II 5.0.17 PTR Patch Notes
item.description:
[News] New patch is released in PTR, which rolls back the balance changes made in 5.0.16 while retaining the updated map pool and bugfixes.

Blizzard
